Esta espeluznante historia sacudió a todo el bosque y ahora casi nadie puede mantenerse alejado de estas extrañas escenas. ¿Y qué harías si tu propia almohada y manta se convirtieran en verdaderos fantasmas? Una verdadera historia de fantasmas, ¡oh, sí!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Tigre del circo visita a su viejo amigo, el Oso. El gato con bigotes y rayas está perplejo con el comportamiento de Masha y trata por todas las maneras posibles de librarse de ella. Sin embargo, cambia de opinión cuando se pierde en el bosque y Masha lo salva en el medio de la noche.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Este cuento educativo nos enseña que nunca se debe descartar la precaución. Mamá Cabra va a recoger repollo, dejando a sus siete hijos solos en casa. El hambriento Lobo intenta entrar a la casa imitando la voz de mamá Cabra para engañar a los pequeños. Logra engañar a seis niños, pero el séptimo, el más pequeño, logra esconderse en el horno. El Lobo intenta entrar a la casa por la chimenea, pero aquí llega Mamá Cabra y encuentra a su séptimo hijo. Ella derrite la estufa y el Lobo se precipita hacia el bosque con la cola quemada. Los otros seis niños regresan a casa y finalmente la familia se reúne.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Esta es una historia sobre un pequeño pero valiente niño. La moraleja de la historia es que no importa cuán grande y alto seas, no debes ofender a los pequeños. Puede suceder que te encuentres con algún pulgarcito, que vencerá a cualquier "gigante".

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: En un bosque encantado vivieron una vez tres cerditos. Eran muy ruidosos y traviesos, reían constantemente y tocaban música. Otras criaturas del bosque, sus vecinos, se cansaron mucho de las travesuras de los cerditos y los expulsaron del bosque. La lección que se puede aprender de esta historia es que siempre debes guardar silencio en lugares públicos y preocuparte por los demás.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Esta historia trata sobre Yemelya, su esposa perezosa y Lucio, que interpreta el papel de un pez de colores en esta historia. La moraleja de la historia: antes de pedir un deseo, es necesario pensar en las consecuencias para ti y las personas que te rodean.

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen en todo tipo de presagios como gatos negros, vestidos al revés, sueños proféticos… La pobre Lucy creía tanto en ese tipo de cosas que incluso temía salir a jugar con sus amigos. ¿Y cómo podrías salir si naciste en el año del conejo púrpura que promete... pase lo que pase... Ya verás...

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: ¿Le tienes miedo a los monstruos? Seguro que sí. Permítanme contarles una historia aterradora sobre un niño que experimentó un miedo real... Esta historia sucedió en una fábrica de tractores abandonada. El niño perdió una pala de su tractor de juguete y decidió buscarla en la fábrica. Así que sube las escaleras y ve a una gran monstruo hembra, que estaba a punto de pintarse los labios con un rodillo. ¡Mientras seguía caminando, notó que más monstruos jugaban dominó! ¡El niño estaba muy aterrorizado y a punto de llorar, cuando se enteró de que era solo un set de película y que todos los monstruos no eran reales! Eran solo actores... ¡Finalmente el niño se dio cuenta de que todos los monstruos de los libros y películas no son reales en absoluto! Pero si quieres ver un monstruo real, ¡mira una mosca bajo un microscopio!

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Masha cuenta una historia sobre truenos y rayos y qué podría suceder si un rayo te atrapa de repente en el parque... mientras disfrutas de tu naranjada.

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: ¡Un niño le tenía tanto miedo al agua que dejó de bañarse y se convirtió en un cerdito! ¡Todos sus amigos huyeron de él asustados! Pero al final superó su miedo y comenzó a lavarse la cara y las manos al darse cuenta de que el agua puede ser segura y divertida. ¡El niño fue muy valiente e incluso ganó una competencia de natación!

programme.title: Las Historias Espeluznantes De Masha
programme.desc: Si crees que solo los niños pequeños tienen miedo de algo, ¡no es verdad! Incluso un animal tan alto como la jirafa tiene sus propios miedos... Por ejemplo, tiene miedo de perder de vista a sus padres y perderse en un safari por el desierto. Masha descubre una extraña ley de la naturaleza: ¡incluso las criaturas más altas pueden ser pequeñas frente a los problemas e incluso la más pequeña puede superar cualquier problema!

programme.title: Special
programme.desc: Para cumplir su sueño, a Oso le falta algo muy pequeño: un yate. Puedes simplemente sentarte ahí y estar triste, pero no pasará con Masha ahí. Ella ayuda a Oso a recuperarse y a encontrar un trabajo. ¡Ahora, Oso es un verdadero fotógrafo de bodas! Pero no puede hacerlo sin un asistente confiable. ¡Con Masha, las fotos van acompañadas de vuelos sobre un velo, carreras con un pastel y persecución de palomas! Ya sea que Oso gane suficiente dinero para un yate o no, ¡ya no estará triste!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha juega muy entretenida a las mamás y los niños, y Rosita ansía probar el sabor de la vida independiente. Por eso se cambia de lugar con los lobos, y ahora son ellos el objeto de preocupacion y cuidado de Masha. En cambio Rosita disfruta de la vida adulta, en la cual no todo es tan fácil....

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un día, Masha encuentra un huevo del cual nace un pingüino. Ahora, el Oso debe cuidar a dos criaturas. Cocina platos especiales y construye un parque acuático en miniatura para el pingüinito y para Masha. Al final, el Oso se da cuenta de que el pingüino estará feliz solo si cuenta con las condiciones climáticas apropiadas, y por eso lo envía en un avioncito hacia la Antártida.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha vuelve a interpretar a madre e hija con Rosie. Pero esta vez un grupo honesto repartió los papeles. Ahora le toca a Masha ponerse la gorra y subirse al cochecito. ¿Soportará Rosie la vida cotidiana de su madre?

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: A los lobos se les ocurre una nueva idea de cómo obtener una fuente de alimento estable y nutritiva... roban una granja avícola y obtienen un ... gallo. Mientras tanto, Masha y la liebre organizan una verdadera búsqueda de huevos para todos sus amigos y vecinos. Todos los habitantes del bosque están muy emocionados de obtener huevos de chocolate a excepción de los lobos que anhelan algo de comida real ... ¡Masha decide ayudar a los pobres y organiza una cena espléndida!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Mientras el Oso está ocupado remendando los hermosos vestidos de Masha, ella hurga en su armario y encuentra una vieja cámara. Toma una foto y descubre que tiene talento para la fotografía. Luego, decide poner a prueba sus habilidades y organizar una sesión fotográfica para todos los animales del bosque.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha y el Oso deciden rodar una película, pero están discutiendo acerca del argumento. - ¿Sobre qué tratará la película? ¿Sobre espías, monstruos o mundos lejanos? ¿O tal vez hay alguna idea más interesante?Masha y el Oso deciden rodar una película, pero están discutiendo acerca del argumento. - ¿Sobre qué tratará la película? ¿Sobre espías, monstruos o mundos lejanos? ¿O tal vez hay alguna idea más interesante?

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha tiene una hermana llamada Dasha. Un buen día, Dasha decide visitar a su hermana. Aunque se parecen mucho físicamente, ¡sus personalidades son muy diferentes! A diferencia de Masha, Dasha es una niña estricta y responsable. Masha está ansiosa por contarle al Oso las noticias y se lleva a Dasha con ella para visitarlo. Y en este momento, la historia se pone todavía más interesante...

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha quiere jugar a las escondidas. Pero el Oso tiene otros planes en mente. Como sabe que es imposible oponerse a los deseos de Masha, acepta jugar con ella. Al igual que muchos niños, Masha "se esconde" simplemente tapándose los ojos con las manos, y por eso el Oso decide ser el que se esconde. Elige los lugares más increíbles. Así y todo, Masha lo encuentra siempre, exige ser ella la que se esconde y vuelve a hacerlo cubriéndose los ojos.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Panda, el primito del Oso, vuelve a visitarlo. Esta vez, su rivalidad con Masha se hace evidente en una fiebre de danza. Mientras el cerdito trata de enseñarles a bailar, el Oso construye el escenario en el jardín. ¡Esta noche, los habitantes del bosque quedarán muy sorprendidos con el espectáculo de baile!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El verano es la época ideal para descansar. ¡Qué agradable es estar sentado a la orilla del río acompañado de tus mejores amigos! Pero en nuestra historia no todo es tan simple... Organizando una pesca de verano, el Oso ni siquiera imaginaba la aventura que le esperaba. Asustadas por su desaparición, Masha y la Osa exploran el terreno, y él... Bueno, miren el capítulo, y lo sabrán todo.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso lucha desesperadamente contra la polilla glotona que apareció en su casa. Con la intención de salvar su caja mágica, la pone en la entrada de la casa. Allí Masha encuentra el sombrero mágico que puede hacerla invisible…

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un día de sol, cuando todos los animales están ocupados con sus actividades diarias, Masha decide hacerle algunas demostraciones de cariño y atención a su Cerdo favorito. Como de costumbre, sus intentos tienen resultados catastróficos para todos los que la rodean. En un intento por escapar de los cuidados de Masha, todos los animales se reúnen en la casa del Oso y expresan su indignación ante la conducta de la niña. Pero el Oso rememora su propia infancia y les recuerda a todos los difícil que es ser un niño.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Todos tienen su comida favorita. Nuestros amigos están listos para disfrutar de algo delicioso en el episodio nuevo. ¿Puede un bocadillo ser sabroso y saludable al mismo tiempo? Masha busca la respuesta a esta simple pregunta y una vez más está convencida de que no hay nada mejor que la avena. ¿Quieres encontrar la respuesta? ¡Mira este episodio y compruébalo por ti mismo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Panda ―el pariente lejano del Oso― llega una vez más de visita. Ambos comienzan a cocinar panecillos chinos, pero entonces aparece Masha, con sus propios métodos de cocina. ¡Y el simple acto de cocinar se convierte en una clase magistral culinaria con mariposas!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso organiza su fiesta de cumpleaños. Todos los animales llegan a su casa para felicitarlo y le llevan algunos regalos. Al ver esto, Masha decide prepararse para su propia fiesta de cumpleaños para evitar cualquier posibilidad de que los animales se olviden de su fiesta y de toda la lista de regalos.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El mejor remedio del aburrimiento es un buen juego. Un buen juego en el teatro es aún mejor. Eso es exactamente lo que decidieron Masha, Dasha, Panda y Rozochka. Lo mas deficil era para acordar que escena poner …

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Llueve torrencialmente afuera y el Oso se dispone a leer un libro. Está seguro de que Masha se quedará en casa con este clima tan feo. Pero pronto Masha aparece en su puerta y le dice que también quiere leer. El Oso decide entretener a la niña con la caja de un mago. Masha comienza a probar todos los trucos mágicos sobre el Oso y él se da cuenta de que no fue una buena idea. Para tener algo de tiempo de lectura, el Oso decide esconderse en la caja del mago, pero Masha inventa un truco todavía más interesante con la situación.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Mamá le pidió a Caperucita Roja que le llevara algunos pasteles a su abuela. Los pasteles olían tan delicioso que la niña decidió sentarse a comer un pastel. De repente, el conejito Roly-Poly se sentó a su lado, por lo que decidió llevarlo con ella a la abuela. Al mismo tiempo, el Lobo, que estaba cerca, escuchó a Caperucita Roja, corrió a la casa de la abuela, se la comió y esperó a que llegara la niña. Cuando apareció, el lobo se la comió junto con el conejito, pero le empezó a doler el estómago, por lo que explotó. El conejito corrió, pero tuvo la mala suerte de encontrarse con el Zorro, que se lo comió. De esta historia, Masha concluye que es muy importante visitar a tu abuela con más frecuencia y ser más prudente.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Este cuento nos habla de un Califa de Oriente, que solía sentarse todo el día frente a la ventana y escuchar el canto de las aves. El Califa era muy poderoso, pero había una cosa que lo decepcionaba: no podía entender el lenguaje de las aves. El pobre Califa se puso a llorar y nadie pudo hacerlo reír. Un día, un enano llegó con el Califa. Prometió ayudarlo a convertirlo en cigüeña. El Califa estuvo de acuerdo y se convirtió en cigüeña. Mientras tanto, el enano se sentó en el trono y se autoproclamó Califa. La pobre cigüeña rompió a llorar y le rogó al enano que le devolviera su apariencia humana y su realeza. Nada hubiera salvado al Califa si un loro pequeño no lo hubiera ayudado a hechizar al enano y devolverle la apariencia humana. Masha concluye que es muy importante aprender idiomas extranjeros.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Esta historia trata sobre un Ali-Baba muy amable, pero muy pobre, y su rico pero codicioso hermano Kasym. Una vez Ali-Baba escuchó el hechizo mágico que abre la capa mágica con numerosos tesoros. Estos tesoros fueron robados por los ladrones y guardados en esta cueva. Un día, Ali-Baba encontró a Kasym y le contó el hechizo secreto. Kasym se metió dentro de la capa, pero accidentalmente olvidó el hechizo y los ladrones lo atraparon. Obligaron a Kasym a aprender todo el libro de cuentos de hadas de memoria y pasar mil días y mil una noches contándoles estas historias. Esta historia nos enseña a estudiar y evitar hacer trampa.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Érase una vez un pescador con su esposa. Cerca vivía el Zorro. Un día, el hombre fue a pescar a un estanque helado. En su camino encontró al Zorro, que fingía estar muerto, y lo recogió. El Hombre empezó a pescar y se quedó dormido sobre un agujero en el hielo. El Lobo vio esto y se alegró porque esperaba conseguir algo de pescado, pero el Zorro le dijo al Lobo que buscara su propio pescador y que si quería comer algo de pescado, debería meter su cola en un agujero de hielo. La cola del lobo se congeló en el hielo y los peces hicieron un lindo árbol de Navidad con ella. El Hombre, su Esposa, el Zorro, el Gato y el Ratón finalmente sacaron la cola del Lobo del agujero y finalmente llegó el Año Nuevo.

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Había un pueblo y un hombre viviendo en este pueblo. En un bosque profundo cerca de ese pueblo, el Oso se instaló. El Oso le pidió al hombre algunos bocadillos. El hombre le dio al oso dos opciones de lo que prefería comer: las puntas o las raíces. El oso decidió tomar las puntas. El hombre cultivó un nabo y le dio las copas al oso. Las copas eran de mal gusto. El Oso le pidió al hombre que probara el nabo. El hombre estuvo de acuerdo con la condición de que el oso lo ayudara con las tareas del hogar y lo mantuviera alejado de las moscas. Mientras ahuyentaba a las moscas, el oso golpeó accidentalmente al hombre en la nariz. El Oso se asustó y se escapó al bosque, llevando el nabo con él. Desde entonces, la gente suele decir "nadie sabe para quien trabaja”.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un día, Masha encuentra un huevo del cual nace un pingüino. Ahora, el Oso debe cuidar a dos criaturas. Cocina platos especiales y construye un parque acuático en miniatura para el pingüinito y para Masha. Al final, el Oso se da cuenta de que el pingüino estará feliz solo si cuenta con las condiciones climáticas apropiadas, y por eso lo envía en un avioncito hacia la Antártida.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso lucha desesperadamente contra la polilla glotona que apareció en su casa. Con la intención de salvar su caja mágica, la pone en la entrada de la casa. Allí Masha encuentra el sombrero mágico que puede hacerla invisible…

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Qué tan difícil es mantener la calma cuando dos pequeños huracanes están en la casa. Panda y Masha estarán bromeando por días. Para lidiar con el estrés, Bear necesita un buen descanso. ¿Podrá restaurar fuerzas internas o dos pequeños no le darán paz?

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Tocar en un cuarteto no es tan facil como parece, sobre todo cuando entre los músicos no hay comprensión. Esto le contará a Masha el papá de Oso, quien vino a visitarla. Además le contará como era el Oso cuando pequeño y como hacía travesuras con el Oso del Himalaya. ¿Habrá cambiado algo desde entonces? Esto lo sabremos en este nuevo capítulo. Y lo más importante, ¡que la música nos une a todos!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Érase una vez un invierno en que el niño Pingüino visitó al Oso. El Oso trató de entretenerlo y de hacerlo participar de diversas actividades, pero el Pingüino pasa la mayor parte del tiempo jugando con Masha. Aunque lo intenta una y otra vez, el Oso no logra llamar la atención del Pingüino y se pone triste. Masha se da cuenta de esto y se le ocurre una idea para arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Masha vuelve a interpretar a madre e hija con Rosie. Pero esta vez un grupo honesto repartió los papeles. Ahora le toca a Masha ponerse la gorra y subirse al cochecito. ¿Soportará Rosie la vida cotidiana de su madre?

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un viejo amigo viene a visitar al Oso y le trae un juego increíble, un billar. Es una perfecta ocasión para competir y divertirse. Pero la cosa se tuerce cuando Masha entra en el juego para complicarlo todo. ¿Quién será el mejor jugador en esta emocionante competición? ¡Busca la respuesta en este nuevo capítulo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¡Al hockey juegan solo los más valientes, fuertes y ágiles! Lo único que se necesita es un equipo preparado y unido, y un entrenador talentoso que lo lleve a la victoria. ¿Pero dónde se puede encontrar tal equipo? ¡Mira este capítulo y lo sabrás!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¡Esta mañana la vida del Oso cambió para siempre! Para sorpresa de todos, Masha crece rápido, lo que preocupa mucho al Oso y a los demás. Su hermanita Dasha decide llevarse a Masha consigo, y se lo comenta por teléfono. El Oso se pone muy triste, y está dispuesto a todo para que se quede, pero al final Masha se va...

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: Un día de sol, cuando todos los animales están ocupados con sus actividades diarias, Masha decide hacerle algunas demostraciones de cariño y atención a su Cerdo favorito. Como de costumbre, sus intentos tienen resultados catastróficos para todos los que la rodean. En un intento por escapar de los cuidados de Masha, todos los animales se reúnen en la casa del Oso y expresan su indignación ante la conducta de la niña. Pero el Oso rememora su propia infancia y les recuerda a todos los difícil que es ser un niño.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: A Masha le encantan los cuentos de hadas y, por supuesto, cree que cada cuento de hadas debería llevar a un final feliz, aunque nada contribuya a ello ¡Así es como debe ser la historia! Oso todavía espera ganar el corazón de la Osa. Él encuentra una antigua góndola en el fondo del lago del bosque. ¡Oso decide restaurarlo e invita a Osa a dar un paseo romántico! Nadie hubiera esperado que esta historia coincidiera perfectamente con el nuevo pasatiempo de Masha: el teatro de marionetas.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: El Oso encuentra un hermoso piano negro en el bosque. Con gusto se lo lleva a su casa, lo repara, lo afina y comienza a tocar. Masha no puede mantener sus manitas lejos del precioso instrumento. Decide convertirse en una pianista de fama mundial y le pide al Oso que le enseñe a tocar el piano.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: A los niños les encanta soñar despiertos y mostrar sus éxitos imaginarios, ¿verdad? ¡Masha y Panda se unen en una verdadera competencia del engaño! Ésta sería una historia muy divertida, !si no se revelaran todos los secretos en el momento más inoportuno!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: La primavera es un tiempo para divertirse y jugar. La nieve se está derritiendo en el bosque, Masha y pingüino se están divirtiendo olvidándose de todo. Como resultado, Masha se enferma. No es fácil estar enfermo, pero es muy agradable cuando hay personas que siempre están listas para cuidarte y entretenerte. Después de todo, ¡la mejor medicina es la risa! Los invitados de Masha han encontrado una receta para una recuperación rápida… ¡el circo!

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: La idea del Oso de colgar un cuadrito en la pared termina causando una enorme explosión, y no le queda más remedio que encargarse de múltiples reparaciones. Masha y los demás animales ayudan al Oso con este difícil trabajo.

programme.title: Masha y el Oso
programme.desc: ¿Te imaginas a Masha como un hada mágica? ¿Qué podría crear con su magia? ¡Sin duda algo encantador y fantástico! En especial cuando el Oso decide organizar un baile de máscaras para levantarle el ánimo a la Osa. - Masha pone todo su esfuerzo para crear una fiesta brillante, memorable y muy campestre, pero su noche mágica no podría sobrevivir sin sus trucos...

programme.title: Los Cuentos De Masha
programme.desc: Esta es la historia del zorro, el gato y el gallo. El astuto zorro quería engañar al gato para comerse el gallo y conseguir un rodillo. No importa cuánto intentó el zorro engañar al gato, se negó a entregarle el gallo al zorro. Para darle una lección, el gato se metió en una bolsa y cuando el zorro la abrió para comerse al gallo, el gato saltó y lo asustó. El punto de la historia es que “si estás bien no busques lo mejor”.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are on a paradise Pacific Island. Well, not exactly paradise, since there is a very active volcano, on which a very active Hefty Smurf risks his life as well as Smurfette's!

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every time Lazy falls asleep, he is caught in the same recurrent nightmare: he is in the power of Morphio, an evil sorcerer who wants to capture as many sleeping souls as possible. One after another, all the Smurfs are going to fall in Morphio's clutches. All of them? Well, maybe not, if Papa Smurf can help it. And Papa Smurf goes to the Sandman for help...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals
programme.desc: Brainy dons his safari hat and roams the forest to do good deeds for animals. He mostly gives advice to the creatures but balks when he can really save the life of a wildcat being hunted by Gargamel. Nat gives Brainy the courage to free the cat from Gargamel's trap.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs
programme.desc: The Wartmongers are draining Smurf River to make mud for their wrestling matches. Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs take Grandpa Smurf to the King's castle so that he can meet Peewit. But what with one thing and another (especially another), the Smurfs and Peewit are taken aboard a Viking long ship. The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | Building Spinnerbaits
programme.desc: Jim shows you how easy it is to build 3 different fish catching spinnerbaits.

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Finding Summer Blue Gills
programme.desc: Jeremy Smith and Dan Lindner roll up their sleeves for a seek and destroy mission to find big summer bluegills.

programme.title: FishON | Remote Smallmouth

programme.title: FishON | Father & Son Challenge
programme.desc: A friendly Father and Son challenge, chasing big walleye in Longlac, Ontario, Canada

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - We Love Fishing the High Sierras, Part Two
programme.desc: The Sierra Nevada mountain range in California is home to many lakes with excellent trout fishing. Thanks to Shea's father, Patt McIntee, June Lake has been a favorite for decades. We spend some time fishing both June Lake and Lake Crowley. Then later, we fish a lake that is brand new to us.

programme.title: Catching Bass | All About Timing
programme.desc: Being in the Right Place at the Right Time for Huge Bass

programme.title: FishON! | Furious Walleye Action on Nagagamisis Lake
programme.desc: The FishON! team ventures to the scenic Nagagamisis Lake, northwest of Hearst, Ontario. Joined by long-time friend Sebastian Lizotte, the day unfolds into an exhilarating fishing adventure with non-stop walleye action—over 60 catches in a single day! This episode highlights the thrill of angling in Northern Ontario's untouched wilderness.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors

programme.desc: A few years back, we rallied up with my buddy Chris Atkins who owns and operates Central America fishing. He told me, Shea, you have to do a Stoked On Fishing Charters Panama trip and fish at Coiba National Park. It's the largest island in Central America, next to the world-famous Hannibal Bank. Needless to say, we rallied up the troops and made our way down south; it's only six hours from LAX our first Adventure was incredible, and that's precisely why we're returning for our second time.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Stoked On Fishing
programme.desc: This past summer (2019), we met a new friend Jason, the CEO of the Catalina Island medical center in the city of Avalon. Jason mentioned that he was in charge of a campaign for the Catalina Island Medical Center Foundation. This campaign aims to raise money to build Catalina Island, a much-needed, state-of-the-art medical center. Jason asked us if we could be one of the big-ticket auction items from the list. We would provide a three-night stay on the stoked on a fishing yacht, two days of fishing on our Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot everglades, and provide fantastic food and drinks when we arrived back in Avalon. We love Catalina, and the idea of creating a hospital for the future of the Island was a no-brainer. We couldn't let this great opportunity go to waste and had epic two days of fishing in San Clemente Island with some new friends.

programme.title: Cafe Racer

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how to detail various aspects of a motorcoach, including wheels and tires, granite care, proper leather care, as well as glass cleaning.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to properly wash your vehicle, from start to finish, starting with the wheels and tires and finishing with cleaning door jambs.

programme.title: Truck U

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Any shop can misdiagnose a problem. All that means is more trips back to the shop for you. Today Bruno and Matt take a look at some of the most commonly misdiagnosed problems and help you fix them for good.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno bring in a pair of Toyota Tundra’s. The only problem, what truck gets what parts? Let the competition begin.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Its our first look at the Ford EcoBoost V6 engine, and we don’t leave anything stock. We’ll keep the more efficient engine and add some power today on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Why build a regular work truck, when you can build the Ultimate Work Truck. Our challenge today is to take a stock 2013 Silverado and outfit it from head to toe, and when we’re done, we’re giving it away.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: We start with a 2012 stock Jeep JK and build it up to get ready to go off-road only at the massive Jeep Beach Event at Daytona International speedway.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

Our good buddy, Scott, is a filmmaker and songwriter who owns a Bohemian bungalow in the heart of Austin’s first suburb. programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: In Stomping Grounds Episode 5, our crew follows the road all the way down to where it ends on the tropical sun-baked island of Key West at the southern tip of the Florida Keys. Surrounded by water, Key West is a boater's paradise with historic seaports and marinas offering a bustling waterfront with historic schooners, dive boats, sport fishing charters, parasailing adventures and scenic coastal excursions. Host Ryan McVinney hops aboard a custom hybrid diesel-electric power catamaran with solar panels, called "Squid" for an in-depth eco-tour of Key West National Wildlife Refuge, including snorkeling in a sponge garden with tropical fish. Next a quick stop in Dry Tortugas National Park via the 110-foot Gladding Hearn power catamaran the "Yankee Freedom III" to visit historic Fort Jefferson, then we jump on a 2020 Sea Hunt 255 Ultra for a ride through the dolphin playground to a secret local boating spot known as Snipe Keys with pristine white sandbars. Back in town we we board the Nau Santa Maria - a replica of Christopher Columbus' sailboat. Finally we head 50 miles offshore to ply the wakes of the shrimp boats with fishing charter captain Chris Trosset aboard his Contender 35ST center console boat.
